ops.title: Uninstall-side cleanup of staged program copies (daemon + helpers)
ops.description: synckit never calls RemoveStableProgram: uninstall leaves the staged ~/.daemonkit/bin/synckitd copy behind today, and once helper staging lands (StableProgramFrom via the stageHelperProgram seam, daemonkit v0.20.7) each helper label adds another staged copy with the same leak. Symmetric cleanup for the pair — or an explicit decision that staged copies persist by design — found 2026-07-26 during the helper-plist fix wave.

ops.text: synckitd uninstall removes its staged copies under ~/.daemonkit/bin (own daemon and helper stages) or documents why they persist
